dataset.description:
This Data Management Plan (DMP) is developed for the postdoctoral research project "Gender Bias Through a Digital Lens: Multimodal Critical Discourse Analysis and Corpus-Based Platform Development for Gender Bias Analysis in Latvian Social Media" (No. 1.1.1.9/LZP/2/25/304).

The purpose of this document is to define the strategies for the lifecycle management of research data generated during the 36-month implementation period (2026–2028). The project focuses on identifying and analyzing gender-based prejudices and stereotypes within the Latvian segment of social media platforms (TikTok, Facebook, Instagram, X, and Threads).

Key Data Activities:

Corpus Creation: Building a "Gold Standard" multi-layered annotated corpus of 2000–3000 units, integrating text, metadata, and multimodal semiotic resources.

Methodology: Utilizing Multimodal Critical Discourse Analysis (MCDA) and the Discourse-Historical Approach (DHA) to tag linguistic and visual features.

Technological Innovation: Structuring data for a vector database using Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to develop a TRL4-level AI analysis platform.

Ethical Compliance: Implementing a strict hybrid anonymization protocol (automated and manual) to safeguard personal data and adhere to GDPR, ensuring the "Right to be Forgotten" while maintaining scientific integrity.

FAIR Implementation: Ensuring all research outputs are Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, and Reusable by depositing them in trusted repositories such as CLARIN-LV and Dataverse.lv.

distribution.title:
Purpose: The data is collected to build a multi-layered annotated corpus of Latvian social media discourse to analyze gender biases. It supports the development of an AI-driven analysis platform (TRL4) using Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).

Relation to Objectives: This data is central to WP2 (Corpus building) and WP3 (Platform development).

Origin: Primary data sourced from public posts on TikTok, Facebook, Instagram, X, and Threads. Secondary data includes expert annotations and metadata.

dmp.description: This Data Management Plan (DMP) describes the lifecycle management of research data for the postdoctoral project No. 1.1.1.9/LZP/2/25/304. The primary objective is to develop a multi-layered annotated corpus of Latvian social media discourse (platforms including TikTok, Facebook, Instagram, and X) to analyze gender biases. The DMP outlines strategies for data collection, hybrid anonymization (using Tilde Anonymise), multimodality processing (image-to-text captions), and the integration of data into a vector database using Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) methods. It ensures compliance with GDPR and FAIR principles (Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, Reusable) throughout the 36-month project duration (01.01.2026.-31.12.2028.).
